id: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
en: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
it: Stai per affrontare un Pokémon leggendario che, se non lo catturi qui, non sarà ottenibile fino al post-game. Vuoi salvare?

id: \bGladion: Looks like it worked, but it didn't fix the issue. Let's see if it will help us now.
en: \bGladion: Looks like it worked, but it didn't fix the issue. Let's see if it will help us now.
it: \bIridio: Sembra che abbia funzionato, ma non ha risolto il problema. Vediamo se ora ci aiuterà.

id: Would you like to go to Ultra Deep Space?
en: Would you like to go to Ultra Deep Space?

id: \rLillie: Nebby evolved again! It can take us to where mother is.
en: \rLillie: Nebby evolved again! It can take us to where mother is.
it: \rLylia: Nebby si è evoluto di nuovo! Può portarci dov'è la mamma.

id: Would you like to take Solgaleo with you?
en: Would you like to take Solgaleo with you?

id: \bGladion: If this Pokémon can get us to where we need to go I say we do it.
en: \bGladion: If this Pokémon can get us to where we need to go I say we do it.
it: \bIridio: Se questo Pokémon può portarci dove dobbiamo andare, io dico di farlo.

id: \bGladion: You made it. I'm the newest member of the Ultra Guardians. I joined at my mother's insistence.
en: \bGladion: You made it. I'm the newest member of the Ultra Guardians. I joined at my mother's insistence.
it: \bIridio: Ce l'hai fatta. Sono il nuovo membro degli Ultraguardiani. Mi sono unito perché mia madre ha insistito.

id: \bIt seems this Lunala is causing the problems in Alola. Let's try and reason with it.
en: \bIt seems this Lunala is causing the problems in Alola. Let's try and reason with it.
it: \bSembra che sia questo Lunala a causare i problemi ad Alola. Proviamo a farlo ragionare.

id: Rotom Dex: Nebby wants us to be prepared. When you're ready to go, talk with it again.
en: Rotom Dex: Nebby wants us to be prepared. When you're ready to go, talk with it again.
it: Rotom Dex: Nebby vuole che siamo preparati. Quando sei pronto a partire, parlagli di nuovo.

id: Solgaleo went into the portal ahead of you.
en: Solgaleo went into the portal ahead of you.
it: Solgaleo è entrato nel portale prima di te.

id: \rLillie: \PN! You saved her! Oh thank you!
en: \rLillie: \PN! You saved her! Oh thank you!

id: \bGladion: It's good to have you back.
en: \bGladion: It's good to have you back.

id: \rLusamine: I'm safe now kids. Let's get everyone back home.
en: \rLusamine: I'm safe now kids. Let's get everyone back home.
it: \rSamina: Ora sono al sicuro, ragazzi. Riportiamo tutti a casa.
